capabilities: show inline gray-text completion suggestions at the cursor
accept suggestions fully or step by word, sentence, or line
configure OpenAI-compatible providers with base URL, key, and model ID
track local usage statistics for predictions, tokens, cache reuse, and latency
filter or re-check suspect suggestions before display
extras: Beta version 0.1.3; requires Obsidian 1.13.0+; installed manually from GitHub Releases attachments. API key is stored in plain text in data.json; usage statistics are in-memory only and reset on restart; mobile support is not yet fully tested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in inline AI completion, so writers lack ghost-text suggestions with fine-grained acceptance and local usage tracking.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible API key (placeholder allowed for free local services)

summary: Inline AI autocomplete that shows gray ghost-text suggestions with word, sentence or line partial acceptance, using a user-configured OpenAI-compatible provider.
